test_title: PYST 158: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Feb, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92312cfb38ccc005335e38cc2c10417cc478d295b6718ec78a10a96c859d718f.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The bigger triangle is removed and the remaining shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/710db819bf8cd4ecb01afd436e2d63195a1f38a2172b4f312c2b6c50a3f1fe81.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The bigger triangle is added and the remaining shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64b8b2018a7ffcc1cf861cae6038bb62511b8b08235f76766a364778d95bfdcf.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The bigger triangle is removed and the remaining shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bb65de8f4a81b60c676d0302cf30e964a6582e8293f1a73bb3dffcc726916d2.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The bigger triangle is added and the remaining shape rotates 90 degrees in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43707265564dc38db845eaecd26e94452efaddf0364285087660fc8ebb6b79b7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (2)".**
